name: Research pipeline
description: Researcher gathers notes on a topic, Critic accepts them or sends them back with questions (a loop bounded by max_loop_visits), Writer turns the accepted notes into a report.

audience.description: Who the report is for, default a technical lead

nodes.task:
Read the notes at {{.state.researcher.notes_path}} on the topic: {{.input.topic}}

Check them for unsupported claims, missing trade-offs and gaps a {{or .input.audience "technical lead"}} would notice. Finish with verdict "approved" when the notes are sound and complete enough to write from, otherwise "changes_requested" with specific questions for the researcher.
